divine.definitionKo: 함부로 가까이할 수 없을 만큼 순결하고 위대하다.
divine.englishDescription: So pure and sublime as to make it hard for people to approach it easily.

divine.definitionKo: 인간이 사는 현실 세계를 뛰어넘어 그 위에 있는.
divine.englishDescription: Existing far beyond the real world where people live.

diy.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 전문가 등에게 맡기지 않고 직접 하는 것.
diy.englishDescription: Doing something yourself rather than leaving it to a professional.

dowry.definitionKo: 결혼할 때 신부가 시댁 어른들에게 드리는 돈이나 물건.
dowry.englishDescription: Money or objects which a bride gives to her groom's family members before a wedding.

dowry.definitionKo: 여자가 결혼을 할 때 친정에서 가지고 가는 돈.
dowry.englishDescription: Money brought by the bride to her husband at marriage.

driver.definitionKo: 기계나 자동차 등의 운전을 직업으로 하는 사람.
driver.englishDescription: A person whose occupation is to operate a machine or car, etc.

driver.definitionKo: 직업적으로 자동차나 기계 등을 운전하는 사람.
driver.englishDescription: A person who drives vehicles or operates machines as a profession.

driver.definitionKo: 골프에서, 공을 멀리 칠 때 쓰는 골프채.
driver.englishDescription: A golf club used to hit a golf ball far in a golf game.

driver.definitionKo: 짐승이나 물고기를 잡기 위해 빠져나갈 수 없는 곳으로 몰아넣는 사람.
driver.englishDescription: A person who drives animals or fish into a place with no exit to hunt them.
A person who drives a car.

driver.definitionKo: 기계나 기구 등을 다루어 움직이게 하는 사람.
driver.englishDescription: A person who handles a machine, device, etc., to make it move.

dying.englishExpression: being near death; dying; being on the verge of death
dying.englishDescription: A state of being almost dead.

earmuffs.definitionKo: 귀를 따뜻하게 하기 위해 귀를 덮는 물건.
earmuffs.englishDescription: An object worn to cover the ears to keep them warm.

elbow-bender.englishExpression: elbow-bender; alcohol enthusiast; lover of alcoholic beverage
elbow-bender.englishDescription: A person who loves and enjoys drinking alcoholic beverages.

embodiment.definitionKo: 비현실적이고 막연한 것이 실제적이고 자세한 형태와 성질을 가지게 됨. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
embodiment.englishDescription: A state in which something unrealistic and vague comes to have a substantial and detailed form and quality; or the act of making this happen.

embodiment.definitionKo: 이념이나 사상, 계획 등을 구체적인 모습으로 나타나게 함.
embodiment.englishDescription: Making an idea, thought, plan, etc., appear in a concrete form.

embodiment.definitionKo: 모습이 분명하지 않은 것을 구체적이고 명확한 모양으로 나타냄.
embodiment.englishDescription: An act of expressing something vague in a concrete and tangible form.

embodiment.definitionKo: 눈에 보이지 않는 어떤 성질이 구체적인 형태로 나타난 것.
embodiment.englishDescription: A state in which a certain intangible quality appears in a concrete form.

enticing.englishDescription: Relating to a quality of stealing someone's mind or heart.
Something that takes away one's mind or attention.

entrap.definitionKo: 꾀를 써서 다른 사람을 곤란하게 만들다.
entrap.englishDescription: To get someone into trouble by using a trick.

exclude.definitionKo: 일부러 한 무리에 끼워 주지 않고 골라내거나 제외하다.
exclude.englishExpression: exclude; put someone on one side; leave someone out
exclude.englishDescription: To deliberately leave out or exclude someone or something from a group.
To leave out as a candidate or in calculation.

exclude.definitionKo: 명단에서 이름을 빼거나 글에서 일부분을 빼다.
exclude.englishDescription: To remove a name from a list or remove a part of a writing.

exclude.definitionKo: 밉거나 싫은 사람을 따로 떼어 멀리하거나 괴롭히다.
exclude.englishDescription: To be separated from, distance oneself from, or give a hard time to someone one hates or does not like.
To leave out something without accepting or including it.

exclude.definitionKo: 싫어하여 끼워 주지 않거나 따돌려 밀어내다.
exclude.englishDescription: To exclude or shut out a person or thing out of hatred.

exclude.definitionKo: 어떤 대상이나 범위에서 빼거나 포기해 버리다.
exclude.englishDescription: To exclude someone from a group or place, or give him/he up.
For a certain group of people to keep someone away or exclude someone.

exclude.definitionKo: 어떤 사람을 따돌려 어울리지 못하게 하다.
exclude.englishDescription: To leave somebody out from socializing.

expedient.definitionKo: 정상적인 절차를 따르지 않은 간편하고 쉬운 방법.
expedient.englishDescription: A simple and easy way, not following a normal procedure.

expulsion.definitionKo: 구성원 명단에서 이름을 뺌으로써 구성원의 자격을 빼앗음. 또는 그런 행위.
expulsion.englishDescription: The act of depriving someone of membership by removing his/her name from the list of members, or such action.

expulsion.definitionKo: 해가 된다고 여겨 일정한 조직이나 지역 또는 나라 밖으로 쫓아냄.
expulsion.englishDescription: An act of sending someone out of a certain organization, region, or country, believing that he/she would harm others.

expulsion.definitionKo: 어떤 지역이나 집단 등에서 쫓아내거나 몰아냄.
expulsion.englishDescription: An act of driving out or expelling someone from a region, organization, etc.

expulsion.definitionKo: 잘못을 한 사람에게 일이나 직장을 그만두게 함.
expulsion.englishDescription: An act of making someone who committed a fault or made a mistake quit a job or leave a workplace.

expulsion.definitionKo: 학교의 학생 기록이나 정당의 구성원으로 등록된 문서에서 이름을 지워 버림.
expulsion.englishDescription: The act of removing someone's name from the list of students of a school or members of a political party.

fad.definitionKo: 한때 사회에 널리 유행함. 또는 그런 것.
fad.englishDescription: A state of being prevalent widely across the society at one point.
(figurative) A spirit or phenomenon rising or sweeping wildly.

fairly.definitionKo: 한쪽으로 치우치지 않고 모든 사람에게 고르게.
fairly.englishDescription: In the manner that treats people equally without preferring one over others.
In a state in which a level, degree, or ability is quite high.

fairly.definitionKo: 하는 일이나 태도가 한쪽으로 치우치거나 그릇됨이 없이 정당하고 떳떳하게.
fairly.englishDescription: In the manner of acting fairly and honorably and treating people without a preference, bias or impropriety.
In the manner of one's mind or behavior being honorable, clear, and right.

fairly.definitionKo: 보통 수준이거나 그보다 조금 더 하게.
fairly.englishDescription: In the state of being equal to or slightly above the average level.
In a sharp and fair manner.
To an extent above the average.

fairly.definitionKo: 상태나 성질 등이 짐작하거나 다스릴 수 있을 정도로.
fairly.englishDescription: In a state in which a state or attribute is easy enough to be estimated or controlled.

faithfully.definitionKo: 남이 시키는 대로 아무 말 없이 그대로 하는 모양.
faithfully.englishDescription: In the manner of quietly doing something as one is told.

faithfully.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 한 번도 빠뜨리지 않고 계속하는 모양.
faithfully.englishDescription: In the manner of continuously doing something without skipping it even once.
Sincerely and genuinely in one's attitude or behavior.

faithfully.definitionKo: 여럿이 질서가 없이 졸졸 뒤따르는 모양.
faithfully.englishDescription: In a manner of a group following someone or something in a disorderly fashion.

faithfully.definitionKo: 남의 뒤를 무질서하게 자꾸 따라다니는 모양.
faithfully.englishDescription: In the manner of continuously following someone or something in an uneven or somewhat disorderly fashion.
In a loyal, honest, and sincere manner.

fare.definitionKo: 교통 기관을 이용하는 데 드는 비용.
fare.englishDescription: The money paid to use transportation modes.

fare.definitionKo: 어떤 물건이나 시설을 이용하고 내는 돈.
fare.englishDescription: Money that a person pays for using a thing or facility.

fare.definitionKo: 시설을 쓰거나 구경을 하는 값으로 내는 돈.
fare.englishDescription: A sum of money paid for using a facility or watching something at a facility.

fare.definitionKo: 사람을 태워 보내거나 물건을 실어 보내는 일에 대한 보수로 주거나 받는 돈.
fare.englishDescription: Money given or received for the service of sending people or goods in a vehicle.

fare.definitionKo: 사람을 태워 보내거나 물건을 실어 보내는 일에 대한 보수로 주거나 받는 돈.
fare.englishDescription: Money given or received in return for the service of sending people or goods in a vehicle.

fare.definitionKo: 사람을 태워 보내거나 물건을 실어 보내는 일에 대한 보수로 주거나 받는 돈.
fare.englishDescription: Money received or paid for transporting people or goods to their destinations.

fatigue.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 술이나 병, 피로 등으로 힘없이 늘어진 몸.
fatigue.englishDescription: (figurative) An extremely exhausted body due to heavy drinking, illness, fatigue, etc.

fatigue.definitionKo: 몸이나 정신이 지쳐서 힘듦. 또는 그런 상태.
fatigue.englishDescription: Being tired and worn-out physically or mentally, or such a state.
The state of being tired and worn-out physically or mentally.

favorableness.definitionKo: 일이 미리 생각한 대로 잘되어 나감.
favorableness.englishDescription: The state of a project, etc., being in smooth progress, as planned.

final.englishDescription: A deciding match, race, or game.
Reaching the last stage or end of a certain task.
The end of a lapse of time.

final.definitionKo: 경기나 대회 등에서, 예비 심사 후 우승자를 결정하기 위한 최종 선발.
final.englishDescription: The final selection to decide the winner after the preliminaries in a game, competition, etc.

flatly.definitionKo: 아주 단호하게 끊거나 과감하게 행동하는 모양.
flatly.englishExpression: resolutely; decisively; flatly; completely; once and for all
flatly.englishDescription: In a manner of one quitting something decisively or acting boldly.

flatly.definitionKo: 결심이나 태도, 입장 등이 흔들림 없이 엄격하고 분명하게.
flatly.englishDescription: In a stern and clear manner without being shaken from a decision, attitude, position, etc.

flatly.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 집착하거나 구차하게 매달리지 않고 마음에 섭섭함이나 불만이 없이.
flatly.englishDescription: Without clinging to something pathetically or without regrets or complaints.

flowerbed.definitionKo: 꽃이 많이 피어있거나 꽃을 심어 가꾸어 놓은 곳.
flowerbed.englishDescription: A place where flowers have bloomed in large numbers or flowers have been cultivated.

forcibleness.englishDescription: A quality which coerces people to comply.

freckle.definitionKo: 얼굴에 생기는, 옅은 얼룩 같은 점.
freckle.englishDescription: A small, stain-like spot on the face.

freckle.definitionKo: 주로 얼굴의 볼 주위에 무리 지어 생기는 작고 검은 점.
freckle.englishDescription: Any of the tiny black spots that form on the face, especially around the cheek.

gift.definitionKo: 고마움을 표현하거나 어떤 일을 축하하기 위해 다른 사람에게 물건을 줌. 또는 그 물건.
gift.englishDescription: The act of giving an object to another person in order to show thanks or celebrate something, or the object itself.

gift.definitionKo: 고마움을 나타내거나 예의를 갖추기 위해서 보내는 물건.
gift.englishDescription: Things sent to someone for expressing one's gratitude or being polite.
In Christianity, the talent God gave to someone.

gil.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit of length.
A bound noun that serves as a unit of length.

giraffe.definitionKo: 이마 양쪽에 짧은 뿔이 있으며 목과 다리가 아주 긴 동물.
giraffe.englishDescription: An animal with two short horns on both sides of the forehead whose neck and legs are very long.

grind.definitionKo: 방망이 등으로 내리쳐서 부수거나 가루로 만들다.
grind.englishDescription: To break something into small pieces or reduce it to powder by pounding it with a stick, etc.

grind.definitionKo: 잘게 부수거나 가루를 내기 위하여 단단한 물건에 대고 문지르거나 으깨다.
grind.englishDescription: To rub or crush one thing against another to break it up into small particles or reduce it to powder.

grind.definitionKo: 금속이나 돌 등을 갈고 닦아 표면을 반질반질하게 하다.
grind.englishDescription: To polish a metal, rock, etc., and smoothen the surface.

grovel.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 남에게 꼼짝하지 못하거나 비굴하게 굴다.
grovel.englishDescription: (slang) To act humble or cowardly before someone.

grudgingly.definitionKo: 사소한 것을 잃는 것에 대하여 아주 아까워하는 모양.
grudgingly.englishDescription: In the manner of begrudging losing even trifling things.

grudgingly.definitionKo: 사소한 것을 잃는 것에 대하여 아주 아까워하는 모양.
grudgingly.englishDescription: With the attitude of begrudgingly losing even a small thing.

gunner.englishDescription: A troop or soldier handling cannons in an army.
A soldier who handles guns or cannons.

gush.definitionKo: 속에 있는 기체나 액체 등을 밖으로 세게 밀어 내다.
gush.englishDescription: To push liquid or gas out of something.

gush.definitionKo: 기분이나 기운, 감정 등을 강하게 드러내 보이다.
gush.englishDescription: To reveal an intense feeling, spirit, emotion, etc.

gush.definitionKo: 속에 있는 기체나 액체 등을 밖으로 세게 밀어 내어 나오게 하다.
gush.englishDescription: To push liquid or gas out of something.

gush.definitionKo: 기분이나 기운, 감정 등을 겉으로 강하게 드러내어 보이다.
gush.englishDescription: To reveal an intense feeling, spirit, emotion, etc.

gush.definitionKo: 눈물이나 땀, 피 등을 한꺼번에 많이 몸 밖으로 내보내다.
gush.englishDescription: To send a large amount of tears, sweats, blood, etc., out of the body at once.
For an emotion, power, etc., to form and rise.
The strong surge of power or energy.

gush.definitionKo: 눈물이나 땀, 피 등이 한꺼번에 많이 흐르다.
gush.englishDescription: For tears, sweat, blood, etc., to flow in a large amount.

guy.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 나 아닌 다른 사람.

haetae.definitionKo: 사자와 비슷하고 머리에 뿔이 있는, 옳고 그름과 착하고 악한 것을 판단하여 안다고 하는 상상 속의 동물.
haetae.englishDescription: A mythical unicorn-lion, an imaginary animal that looks like a lion with horns on its head, said to judge right from wrong, and good from evil.

hallway.definitionKo: 건물 안에서 여러 방으로 통하게 만들어 놓은 통로.
hallway.englishDescription: A passage in a building, into which the doors of rooms open.

hamburger.definitionKo: 둥근 빵 사이에 고기와 채소와 치즈 등을 끼운 음식.
hamburger.englishDescription: Food made by putting meat, vegetables, cheese, etc., between two round buns.

hamlet.definitionKo: 주로 시골에서, 여러 집이 모여 사는 곳.
hamlet.englishDescription: A community consisting of several houses, usually in a rural area.
A small village in a rural area.

hasty.definitionKo: 말이나 행동이 조심성 없고 신중하지 못하다.
hasty.englishDescription: Careless and thoughtless in speaking or behaving.
A behavior or performance being poorly or clumsily done.

headlight.definitionKo: 앞을 비추기 위해 기차나 자동차 등의 앞에 단 등.
headlight.englishDescription: A light installed on the front of a train, car, etc., to illuminate the place ahead.

headlight.definitionKo: 앞을 비추기 위해 기차나 자동차 등의 앞에 단 등.
headlight.englishDescription: A light attached to the front of a train or car, etc., to light the way ahead.

heritage.definitionKo: 어떤 집단이나 공동체에서 지난 시대부터 전해 내려오면서 고유하게 만들어진 사상, 관습, 행동 등의 양식.
heritage.englishDescription: A way of life including thoughts, customs, forms of behavior, etc., that have been uniquely formed and passed on from previous generations in a group or community.

hideous.definitionKo: 모양이 흉하고 보기 싫게 생긴 데가 있다.
hideous.englishDescription: A person or animal looking ugly and unpleasant to see.

hideous.definitionKo: 모습이 보기에 기분이 나쁠 만큼 흉하고 거칠다.
모습이 보기에 기분이 나쁠 만큼 몹시 흉하고 거칠다.
생김새나 태도가 마음에 들지 않거나 징그럽다.
hideous.englishDescription: Appearance or attitude being unsatisfactory or displeasing.

hieroglyphics.definitionKo: 한자를 만드는 여섯 가지 방법의 하나로, 물체의 모습을 본떠서 글자를 만드는 방법.
hieroglyphics.englishDescription: One of six methods of making Chinese characters, which is to make characters by imitating the shapes of objects.

hieroglyphics.definitionKo: 한자를 만드는 여섯 가지 방법의 하나로, 물체의 모습을 본떠서 만든 글자.
hieroglyphics.englishDescription: The characters made by imitating the shapes of objects, using one of six methods of making Chinese characters.

hoot.definitionKo: 기차나 배의 경적이나 나팔이 울리는 소리.
hoot.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of a train or ship honking or a bugle sounding.

hospitabillity.definitionKo: 찾아온 사람을 반갑게 맞아 정성껏 대접함.
hospitabillity.englishDescription: An act of welcoming a visitor warmly and treating him/her in a sincere manner.

hostility.englishDescription: A feeling of opposition or defiance.
The feeling of hating and envying each other.

hostility.definitionKo: 다른 사람이나 대상에 맞서 달려들거나 부딪히려는 마음.
hostility.englishDescription: An urge to confront, attack or collide with another person or object.

hostility.definitionKo: 적이나 상대를 깊이 미워하여 분하게 여기거나 싸우고 싶어 하는 마음.
hostility.englishDescription: The attitude of resenting or wanting to fight against one's enemy or opponent due to deep hatred.

hostility.definitionKo: 적이나 그와 같은 대상으로 대하는 감정.
hostility.englishDescription: The sentiment of treating someone as an enemy or something similar.

hostility.definitionKo: 적이나 그와 같은 대상으로 대하는 마음.
hostility.englishDescription: The sentiment of treating someone as an enemy or something similar.
An attitude that treats someone as an enemy.
A state of being inclined to fight.

house.englishDescription: A house where people live and reside.
A house where a family lives.

house.definitionKo: 사람이 살 수 있도록 만든 건물.
house.englishDescription: A building constructed for human habitation.

house.definitionKo: 한 가구만 살 수 있게 한 채씩 따로 지은 집.
house.englishDescription: A housing unit built individually for habitation by a single family.

house.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물이 추위나 더위 등을 막고 그 속에 들어 살기 위해 지은 건물.
house.englishDescription: A structure built by a human or animal to serve as protection from cold, heat, etc., and as a place to live in.

house.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물이 살기 위해 지은 건물을 세는 단위.
house.englishDescription: A unit of counting houses built by humans or animals to live in.

house.definitionKo: 가족을 구성원으로 하여 생활을 하는 공동체. 또는 가까운 일가.
house.englishDescription: A community consisting of family members who live together, or close relatives.
A house inhabited by a human being.
A big house that has the Chinese character 'jeon(殿)' or 'gak(閣)' in its name.
(honorific) One's concubine or the house where she lives.
One's concubine or the house where she lives.

nightingale.definitionKo: 털빛이 노랗고 울음소리가 매우 아름다운 여름 철새.
nightingale.englishDescription: A summer bird with yellow feathers, which sings very beautifully.

nocturnality.definitionKo: 낮에 쉬고 밤에 활동하는 동물의 습성.
nocturnality.englishDescription: An animal's habit of resting during the day and being active at night.

non-prosecution.definitionKo: 법률에서, 사건이 죄가 되지 않거나 범죄를 증명할 수 없을 때 검사가 법원에 공소를 요청하지 않음.
non-prosecution.englishDescription: In law, when a case is not a crime or a crime cannot be proven, the prosecutor does not request the court to initiate an indictment.

nostril.englishDescription: Each of two holes inside one's nose.

nunnery.definitionKo: 가톨릭에서, 수녀들이 함께 생활하면서 수행을 하는 곳.
nunnery.englishDescription: A place where nuns live together to practice asceticism in Catholicism.

obligation.englishDescription: Something that one should do as a matter of course.

obligation.definitionKo: 법으로 정해져 강제성이 있는, 반드시 해야 하는 일.
obligation.englishDescription: Something that one is required to do mandatorily by law.
The act of undertaking a job or bearing a responsibility or duty.
A mission or role one is required or expected to do.
A task or duty that one is responsible for.

obligation.definitionKo: 사람이 마땅히 지켜야 할 바른 마음가짐이나 몸가짐.
obligation.englishDescription: The right mental or physical attitude that a person should have.

obligation.definitionKo: 어떤 자격이나 신분으로서 해야 할 도리나 임무.
obligation.englishDescription: The duty or responsibility required for someone in a certain qualification or title.
A task or duty that one is responsible for.

okay.definitionKo: 남의 주의를 끌려고 할 때에 하는 말.
okay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker attracts someone's attention.

okay.definitionKo: ‘그렇게 하겠다, 그렇다, 알았다’ 등 긍정하는 뜻으로, 대답할 때 쓰는 말.
okay.englishDescription: An exclamation used when giving a positive answer that means 'I'll do so', 'Yes, it is', or 'I see.'

okay.definitionKo: 걱정되거나 문제될 것이 없어 허락할 수 있다.
okay.englishDescription: Being allowed because there is nothing to worry about or no problems.

okay.definitionKo: 아랫사람의 부름에 대답할 때 하는 말.
okay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker answers the call of someone junior to him/her.

okay.definitionKo: 아랫사람의 물음이나 부탁에 긍정하여 대답할 때 하는 말.
okay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker answers in the affirmative to the question or request of someone junior to him/her.

okay.definitionKo: 어떤 사실을 긍정하거나 다짐할 때 하는 말.
okay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker acknowledges or swears something.

okay.definitionKo: 어떤 행동이나 일 등이 문제될 것이 없다.
okay.englishDescription: Having no problems with behavior, work, etc.

okay.definitionKo: 단단히 마음을 먹고 결심을 할 때 하는 말.
okay.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when one is determined and has a strong resolve.

oops.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker is startled.

oops.definitionKo: 잘못된 것을 갑자기 깨달았을 때 하는 말.
oops.englishExpression: my goodness; oh my gosh; oops
oops.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker realizes suddenly that there is something wrong.

ouch.definitionKo: 갑자기 아픔을 느낄 때 나오는 소리.
ouch.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels a sudden pain.

ouch.definitionKo: 아프거나 힘들거나 놀라거나 기막힐 때 내는 소리.
ouch.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels painful, tired, surprised, or absurd.

ouch.definitionKo: 아프거나 힘들거나 놀라거나 기막힐 때 내는 소리.
ouch.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels painful, tired, surprised, or absurd.
An exclamation uttered when the speaker feels a pain or ache.

oust.definitionKo: 어떤 생각이나 상태, 지위 등을 억지로 없어지게 하거나 빼앗다.
oust.englishDescription: To forcibly get rid of or take away a certain thought, position, state, etc.

oust.definitionKo: 권력을 가진 집단이나 사람이 권력을 유지하기 위하여 반대하는 세력을 몰아내다.
oust.englishDescription: To eradicate opposition forces so that a group or person of authority can maintain their power.

oust.definitionKo: 어떤 지역이나 집단 등에서 쫓아내거나 몰아내다.
oust.englishDescription: To drive out or expel someone from a region, organization, etc.
To expel someone from a certain position.

overeat.definitionKo: 약이나 음식 등을 지나치게 많이 먹거나 돈을 지나치게 많이 쓰다.
overeat.englishDescription: To eat too much food, take too much medicine or spend too much money.

ovulation.definitionKo: 난소에서 성숙한 난자가 자궁으로 나오는 일.
ovulation.englishDescription: A process that mature eggs leave the ovary and travel into the uterus.

particularized.englishDescription: Concrete and clear even in insignificant parts.

perilla.definitionKo: 독특한 냄새가 나는 잎은 반찬으로 먹고 씨는 볶아서 양념으로 쓰거나 기름을 짜는 채소. 또는 그 씨.
perilla.englishDescription: A vegetable with a unique smell, of which the leaves are eaten as side dishes and the seeds are roasted and used as seasoning or squeezed for oil, or its seed.

perpetuity.englishDescription: The state of lasting and continuing forever.

physics.definitionKo: 자연 과학의 한 분야로, 물질의 물리적 성질과 그것이 나타내는 모든 현상 그리고 그들 사이의 관계나 법칙을 연구하는 학문.
physics.englishDescription: A field of natural science that  studies the physical properties of objects and all their phenomena, and the relations and laws among them.

physics.definitionKo: 물질의 원리에 기초한 성질과 그 성질에서 비롯되는 모든 현상, 그 관계나 법칙을 연구하는 학문.
physics.englishDescription: A quality based on the principle of substance, and all the phenomena stemming from such a quality, or an academic field that studies the relationship or laws working among them.

pimple.englishDescription: A small pointy swelling of the skin.

piri.definitionKo: 여덟 개의 구멍이 있고 세로로 부는 목관 악기.
piri.englishDescription: pipe: A woodwind instrument with eight holes, whose player produces sounds by blowing in vertically.

piri.definitionKo: 속이 빈 막대에 구멍을 뚫고 불어서 소리를 내는 모든 악기.
piri.englishDescription: pipe: Any musical instrument, with holes on an empty pipe, which produces sounds when blown.

poland.definitionKo: 동유럽 북부에 있는 나라. 국토의 대부분이 평야이며 주요 생산물로는 밀, 감자 등이 있다. 공용어는 폴란드어이고 수도는 바르샤바이다.
poland.englishDescription: A country located in the northern part of eastern Europe; most of its land is flat; its main produce is wheat, potatoes, etc.; its official language is Polish; its capital is Warsaw.

pool.definitionKo: 네모난 대 위에 공을 놓고 긴 막대기로 쳐서 맞히는 것으로 이기고 지는 것을 가리는 실내 경기.
pool.englishDescription: An indoor recreational game, whose players strike a ball with a long stick on a rectangular billiard table.
For blood to pool and gather beneath or on the skin.

pool.definitionKo: 땅이 아래로 우묵하게 파여 물이 모여 있는 곳.
pool.englishDescription: A hollow area in the ground, where water gathers.

pool.definitionKo: 헤엄을 치면서 놀거나 수영 경기를 할 수 있도록 시설을 갖춘 곳.
pool.englishDescription: A place complete with facilities that allow one to spend time swimming or hold a swimming competition.

prickle.definitionKo: 살에 박힌 나무의 가늘고 뾰족한 부분.

prickle.englishDescription: For an object to grow thinner and pointed toward the end as it sticks out, or to make something become that way.

primitiveness.englishDescription: A state in which a level is behind a certain standard.

profess.definitionKo: 어떤 이유를 붙여 자신의 주장이나 처지를 앞에 내세우다.
profess.englishDescription: To place a certain cause ahead of one's own argument or situation.

prove.definitionKo: 수학이나 논리학에서, 어떤 명제나 판단이 진실인지 아닌지를 근본 원리로부터 이끌어 내어 밝히다.
prove.englishDescription: To demonstrate that a proposition or judgment is true by using fundamental principles, in mathematics or logic.

prove.definitionKo: 국가나 공공 단체의 권한으로 어떤 사실이 진실임을 공적으로 밝히다.
prove.englishDescription: To officially announce that something is true with the authority of a government or public entity.
To inspect and prove that something is true.

prove.englishDescription: To prove the right or wrong of an argument or theory through logical reasoning.
To do something that is expected of one.
To use something as reliable proof.
To judge a certain fact and announce it clearly.

prudence.englishDescription: A state of being prudent, not careless in one's thought.
An act of being careful about one's words or actions so as not to make a mistake.
The state of being very careful.

punish.englishDescription: To find someone's fault and punish him/her.

punish.definitionKo: 잘못에 대한 대가로 몸을 불편하고 괴롭게 만들다.
punish.englishDescription: To make someone uncomfortable and painful physically .

punish.definitionKo: 잘못하거나 죄를 저지른 사람에게 벌을 주다.
punish.englishDescription: To punish someone who did something wrong or committed a crime.

punish.definitionKo: 잘못을 깨닫고 뉘우치도록 벌을 주어 나무라다.

To rebuke and talk harshly to someone so that he/she regrets his/her mistake or wrongdoing.

punish.definitionKo: 옳지 않은 행동에 대하여 벌을 주다.
punish.englishExpression: punish; penalize; take a disciplinary action
punish.englishDescription: To punish someone for his/her wrongdoing.

punish.definitionKo: 옳지 않은 일을 하거나 죄를 지은 사람에게 벌을 주다.
punish.englishDescription: To punish a person who committed wrongdoing or a crime.
To deal with something according to a judgement.

punish.definitionKo: 범죄를 저지른 사람에게 국가나 특정 기관이 제재나 벌을 주다.
punish.englishDescription: For the state or a related institution to give a penalty to or punish a criminal for what he/she has done.
To scold someone harshly or punish him/her.
To severely scold someone in a loud manner.
To punish and reprimand someone in a loud voice.

purification.definitionKo: 제사나 중요한 일 등을 앞두고 부정을 타지 않도록 몸을 깨끗이 씻고 몸가짐을 다듬는 일.
purification.englishDescription: An act of taking a bath and putting on clean clothes to prevent bad luck before an ancestral rite or an important occasion.

purification.definitionKo: 권력을 가진 집단이나 사람이 권력을 유지하기 위하여 반대하는 세력을 몰아냄.
purification.englishDescription: The act of eradicating opposition forces so that a group or person of authority can maintain their power.
The act of making someone or something pure by eliminating impurities.

purification.definitionKo: 사람을 가르쳐 생각이나 감정을 바람직하게 변하게 함.
purification.englishDescription: The act of causing someone to change his/her thoughts or feelings in a desirable manner by teaching him/her.
The act of making someone or something pure by eliminating impurities.

purification.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 주로 부정적인 요소를 걸러 내는 과정.
purification.englishDescription: (figurative) The process of eliminating elements that are usually negative.

purification.definitionKo: 더러운 것이나 순수하지 않은 것을 깨끗하게 함.
purification.englishDescription: The act of making something dirty or impure cleaner.

purification.definitionKo: 마음속의 우울, 불안, 긴장 등을 해소하고 마음을 깨끗하게 함.
purification.englishDescription: The act of removing feelings of depression, anxiety, nervousness, etc., and purifying one's mind.

purpose.englishDescription: One's idea or plan to do something.
The area or purpose for which something is used.

purpose.definitionKo: 이루려고 하는 일이나 나아가고자 하는 방향.
purpose.englishDescription: Something one wants to achieve or the direction one wants to head.

purpose.definitionKo: 자기가 마땅히 해야 할 일이나 책임.

purpose.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 근본이 되는 목적이나 매우 중요한 뜻.

quash.englishDescription: To annul the original decision in a trial.

questionnaire.definitionKo: 어떤 사실을 조사하기 위해서 여러 사람에게 질문함. 또는 그러한 질문.
questionnaire.englishDescription: The act of questioning people in order to research into a certain fact, or such questions.

questionnaire.englishDescription: A document containing questions for the purpose of conducting a research or an investigation.

quince.definitionKo: 향기가 좋아 설탕에 절여 먹거나 차를 달여 먹거나 한약의 재료로 쓰는 타원형의 노란 열매.
quince.englishDescription: An oval-shaped, yellowish fruit that one consumes by fermenting with sugar or making into a tea; enjoyed for its pleasant aroma or used as an ingredient in herbal medicine.

ramblingly.englishDescription: In the state of a speech or writing being unnecessarily complex and long-winded.

raspingly.definitionKo: 어딘가에 붙어 있는 것을 계속해서 긁어내는 소리.
raspingly.englishDescription: In a scratchy sound, when something attached to a surface is continuously scratched.

re-air.definitionKo: 라디오나 텔레비전 등에서 이미 방송했던 프로그램을 다시 방송하다.
re-air.englishDescription: To air again a show that has already been aired on radio, TV, etc.

rebirth.englishDescription: A state of returning from the dead.

recess.englishDescription: A period of time in which one takes a brief rest while doing something.
An act of taking a brief break in a court trial.

recess.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하다가 잠깐 동안 쉼.
recess.englishDescription: An act of taking a brief rest while doing something.
An act of stopping what one was doing and taking a brief rest.

reckoning.englishDescription: The act of expecting or considering something in advance.

reckoning.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 자신에게 이익인지 손해인지 따짐.
reckoning.englishDescription: The act of calculating the profits and losses of something.

reconsider.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 대하여 굳게 정한 마음을 바꾸어 다르게 생각하다.
reconsider.englishDescription: To change one's firm opinion on something and think differently.

reconsider.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 문제 등에 대하여 다시 생각하다.
reconsider.englishDescription: To think about a matter, issue, etc., again.

reconsider.definitionKo: 한 번 검토한 것을 다시 검토하다.
reconsider.englishDescription: To review what has already been reviewed.

rectifying.definitionKo: (옛날에) 옳지 못한 임금을 밀어내고 새 임금을 세워 나라를 바로잡음.
rectifying.englishExpression: rectifying; restoring things to a proper state
rectifying.englishDescription: (archaic) The act of forcing out an unjust king and putting a new king on the throne to restore proper order in a state.

reelect.definitionKo: 선거가 무효가 되었을 때, 또는 당선인이 없거나 결격 사유가 드러났을 때 다시 선거를 실시하다.
reelect.englishDescription: To hold an election again when the original election is nullified, there is no winner or the winner is disqualified.

regimen.definitionKo: 건강을 지키기 위하여 음식을 가려 먹거나 올바른 생활을 함.
regimen.englishDescription: The manner of keeping a certain diet or leading a good life in order to be healthy.

register.englishDescription: To register a certain subject in a school, academy, etc.

register.definitionKo: 법률에서, 허가나 인정을 받기 위해 이름 등을 행정 관서나 공공 기관의 문서에 기록되게 하다.
register.englishDescription: In law, for one's name to be recorded in the document of an administrative or public agency in applying for permission or recognition.

register.definitionKo: 학원이나 학교에 정식 학생으로 이름을 올리거나 단체에 회원으로 이름을 올리다.
register.englishDescription: To put one's name on the list of regular students of an educational institute or school, or on the list of members of a group.

register.definitionKo: 어떤 일의 근거가 되도록 내용을 일정한 양식으로 기록한 장부.
register.englishDescription: A book that documents something in a uniform format so as to use it as a reason for a certain work.

register.definitionKo: 이름이나 어떤 내용을 장부에 적어 올리다.
register.englishDescription: To record a name or content on a ledger.

register.definitionKo: 관청에서 개인의 부동산에 대한 권리나 사실 관계를 기록해 두는 장부.
register.englishDescription: A book that records the rights or factual grounds of an individual's property at a government office.

register.definitionKo: 땅이나 집 같은 부동산에 대한 권리 관계를 법정 절차에 따라 등기부에 기록하다.
register.englishDescription: To record on the register the rights or factual grounds of an individual's property such as land or house according to the legal procedure.

register.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 관련되거나 조직에 속한 사람의 이름이나 주소, 연락처 등을 적어 놓은 장부.
register.englishDescription: A book of names, addresses, telephone numbers, etc., for members of an organization or for those concerned with a certain matter.

relieve.englishDescription: To make the symptom of a disease get better.

relieve.englishDescription: To address and get rid of a difficult problem or unfavorable situation.

return.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 들인 노력에 대한 보수.

return.definitionKo: 다시 원래의 상태로 되다.

return.definitionKo: 남에게 도움을 받은 만큼 되돌려주다.
return.englishDescription: To give back what one benefits from others.
